If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. 14. For non-emergency situations, contact a poison control center right away. 15. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Notes: 16. Ensure you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose: 18. It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. 19. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. Storage: 20.
